captions.instagram:
Secrets: Five Days Before Christmas, 1990.

I've asked my aunt to tell me this story at least fifteen times. It starts in my grandparents' living room, under a Christmas tree bright enough to light the whole room. It ends in the backyard, under a trellis dripping with honeysuckle, with the hum of a car engine.

From Not Plain. Read it at the link in bio.

#memoir #narrativenonfiction #truestory #substack
